h1: Structured cabling, certified to the link
lede: Twenty-four years of copper and fibre installation, now inside Purview DC. From a single office floor to a 100-rack GPU hall: survey, design, install, test and document, with every link certified before handover.

blocks.text: The foundation everything else runs on

Structured cabling is the physical layer of business connectivity. Done well it is invisible for twenty years; done badly it is the cause of every intermittent fault nobody can find. Purview's cabling practice began in Australia in 2002 as EDF, joined Purview Group as EDF Purview and now delivers worldwide under Purview DC: Cat6 and Cat6A copper, single-mode and multi-mode fibre, MPO trunks and InfiniBand fabrics for data centres, offices, campuses and industrial sites.

items.title: Data centres
items.body: Structured and point-to-point cabling for GPU halls, hyperscale, sovereign and enterprise sites. MPO-8/12/16/24 fibre, InfiniBand and RoCE fabrics, patch panels, dressing and labelling to the rack build instructions.

items.title: Offices and campuses
items.body: Cat6A horizontal cabling, backbone fibre, wireless survey and deployment, AV and security cabling, for new builds, fit-outs and relocations.

items.title: Industrial and education
items.body: Plants, warehouses, laboratories and universities, including the Macquarie University Law School (Michael Kirby Building) delivered on CommScope.

items.title: Why it sits in Purview DC
items.body: The same crews that cable a GPU floor cable your office. One certified-installer standard, one test method, one handover pack, whichever the site.

blocks.text: Survey to support, under one team

items.title: Design and estimating
items.body: Site survey and assessment of the existing infrastructure Cabling architecture designed for the workload and for growth Design specifications and bill of materials BIM where the project uses it, so decisions are made early and changes are not made on site Fixed-price estimate with options

items.title: Installation
items.body: Certified technicians from start to finish Cat6 and Cat6A copper; OS2 and OM4/OM5 fibre; MPO trunks and cassettes Containment, pathways, cabinets and racks Dressing, labelling and documentation to a single scheme Minimal disruption in live buildings and live halls

items.title: Testing and certification
items.body: Every copper link certified to Level VI on Fluke DSX-8000 Every fibre link OTDR and insertion-loss tested; MPO polarity verified Results submitted for manufacturer warranty (up to 25 years) As-builts, test results and asset register in the handover pack

items.title: Project management
items.body: A dedicated project manager from consultation to handover Scheduling around occupancy and change windows to minimise downtime Materials, logistics and crew resourcing Quality gates: engineering release, site validation, installation verification, independent acceptance QA Risk assessments and method statements for every site

items.title: Smart hands and support
items.body: IMACD: install, move, add, change, decommission Infrastructure refresh: cabinet, rack and stack Relocation and data migration Cable patching and tidy-up Audit, asset management and labelling IT asset recycling and secure erasure

items.title: Network and AV infrastructure
items.body: AV over IP, HDBaseT and conferencing room cabling ( Audio Visual → ) Enterprise firewall refresh Core and access switch deployment Wireless surveys and deployment, WiFi6 Network configuration and validation ICT infrastructure migration AI Infrastructure →

blocks.text: Preparation-first, the same as a GPU floor

Cabling material is received, verified, pre-terminated where possible and labelled in prestaging before it reaches the site, which is why our installs finish on the date and our test sheets come back clean.

items.title: Survey and design
items.body: Site walk, existing estate, pathways, outlet and rack counts, architecture and estimate

items.title: Prestage
items.body: Material receipt, pre-termination, labelling, engineering release

items.title: Install and certify
items.body: Containment, pulls, termination, dressing; Level VI copper and OTDR fibre on every link

items.title: Handover and support
items.body: As-builts, warranty registration, asset register; smart hands under contract

blocks.title: Macquarie University Law School, Sydney
blocks.body: Structured cabling for the Michael Kirby Building: teaching, workplace and research spaces plus a suspended moot court, delivered on CommScope as a certified installer and documented in a CommScope case study. Alongside it, the same practice has certified 185,000+ links on AI data centre floors in Australia, the Middle East, the US and India.

blocks.text: We hold installer certification across the leading cabling systems, so the recommendation is made on your requirement and your warranty, not on one supplier's catalogue.
